headline: Fixes a stuck layout, and a clearer tour.
notes: Fixed: after closing the tour or resizing the panel, the buttons could get stuck as small icon-only tiles with empty space below. The panel now switches back to the full layout by itself
The tour shows Alt-click, Shift-click and Cmd-click (Ctrl-click on Windows) on their own lines, in bold, and points out the Versions list
In Settings > Naming, each shortcut row now says what it does: next version, custom name, alternative
Fixed: a custom pattern using {project} could give two version numbers (VersionUp_v8_v5). {project} now fills in with your project's name without its version number
"Name details" in Settings is now called "Project name"
